children: iBio, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results showing revenue of $100K versus $400K a year earlier and a net loss of ($33.04M) for the year, with diluted loss per share of ($0.32). The results reflect continued investment in research and development and clinical programs.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Loss per common share - basic and diluted”.

Pipeline advancement: IBIO-600 entered a Phase 1 single-ascending-dose trial with 31 participants dosed; IBIO-610 is advancing CMC and toxicology work toward a planned first-in-human study in H1 2027.

Preclinical differentiation: IBIO-610 and IBIO-600 showed fat-selective weight loss and preservation of lean mass in rodent and non-human primate studies, and demonstrated complementary effects when combined with semaglutide.

Platform and discovery: AI-driven antibody discovery progressed multiple programs, including nomination of an IBIO-800 bispecific in June 2026 and preclinical validation of engineered amylin receptor antibodies.
Funding and runway: A 2025 public offering, a 2026 private placement and warrant exercises provided cash runway projected into Q4 FY2028 to support R&D and clinical activity.
